mainEntity.name: What is trade scheduling in construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Trade scheduling in construction involves organizing and coordinating the various specialized trades—such as plumbers, electricians, and carpenters—that contribute to a building project. It dictates the sequence of their work, ensuring that each trade arrives on-site when their work can commence and without hindering other ongoing activities. Effective trade scheduling minimizes delays, optimizes resource allocation, and helps maintain the project timeline and budget.
